name: Manager - Check for Team, Download Letter for 2024
goal: Manager uses 'Check for team' to request a team member's 2024 appraisal letter for download.
constraints: menuType is 'check for team', isManagerAllowed is 'yes'. User selects 'Check for team', enters Ecode, selects 2024, chooses download. Tool returns webViewLink.

phases.description: Run setup workflow and confirm menuType is 'check for team' and isManagerAllowed is 'yes'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot presents quick replies: Check for team, 2026, 2025, Others.
Bot presents year quick replies: 2026, 2025, 2024, Others.
Bot triggers workflow and provides webViewLink.

phases.description: Bot shows link and asks for further questions.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot message includes download link and 'Do you have any other questions?'

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
